newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian tin prices up, copper, zinc, nickel steady.
newsitem.headline: Indian tin prices up, copper, zinc, nickel steady.

text.p: Indian tin prices gained on Monday while other base metals remained steady, dealers said.
Ready tin rose by 100 rupees to 34,500 rupees per quintal on thin supplies, shortage of ready stock and stray physical support. Tin was up by 100 rupees on Saturday.

Copper was steady at 12,400 rupees, zinc at 6,450 rupees and lead at 4,450 rupees. Nickel remained steady at the improved level of 36,700 rupees on limited inflows. Nickel was up by 200 rupees per quintal on Saturday.
Overall sentiment was unchanged in the absence of any fresh news from the oversees market ahead of the Christmas holidays, a broker said. The market may move in narrow range, he added.
